title: Immiscible（标准与 lulynx 配对方案）

standard.summary: l2 路径提供 standard 全局最小成本 Hungarian assignment 与 lulynx_greedy 逐行贪心；cosine 继续使用既有 flow OT 路径。
standard.effect: standard 保证 batch 内全局最小 L2 配对成本；lulynx_greedy 保持历史行为、开销更低但不保证全局最优。两者质量收益都需要同条件 A/B 验证。
standard.whenToUse: 仅在已验证当前 batch size 与数据分布适合时启用；默认关闭。
standard.avoidWhen: batch size 太小时排序效果有限。有轻微排序开销。

standard_en.summary: The l2 path offers standard, a globally minimum-cost Hungarian assignment, and lulynx_greedy, a row-by-row greedy match; cosine continues to use the existing flow OT path.
standard_en.effect: standard guarantees the globally minimum L2 pairing cost within the batch; lulynx_greedy keeps the historical behaviour at lower cost without guaranteeing global optimality. Either way, the quality benefit needs an A/B under matched conditions.
standard_en.whenToUse: Only once you have verified that your batch size and data distribution suit it; off by default.
standard_en.avoidWhen: The sorting achieves little at a very small batch size. There is a slight sorting overhead.

advanced.principle: 两种 l2 模式共享 O(B^2) 距离矩阵。standard 用 Hungarian 求全局最优双射；lulynx_greedy 按样本顺序选择未使用的最小距离。cosine 是独立的 flow OT 近似，不受 assignment mode 影响。
advanced.intervention: immiscible_assignment_mode=standard|lulynx_greedy 由既有 request/config 进入 training_step_noise_timestep_handler.py → immiscible_diffusion.py。
advanced.expectedImpact: standard 与 lulynx 模式的速度、收敛和质量必须按相同模型、数据、seed、步数做 A/B；不能从论文外推 lulynx 结果。
advanced.tradeoffs: 需要 batch 内计算配对距离，有 O(N²) 排序开销。

advanced_en.principle: The two l2 modes share an O(B²) distance matrix. standard uses Hungarian matching for the globally optimal bijection; lulynx_greedy picks the smallest unused distance in sample order. cosine is an independent flow-OT approximation, unaffected by assignment mode.
advanced_en.intervention: immiscible_assignment_mode=standard|lulynx_greedy enters training_step_noise_timestep_handler.py → immiscible_diffusion.py via the existing request/config path.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: standard vs lulynx modes' speed, convergence, and quality must be A/B'd on the same model, data, seed, and step count; do not extrapolate paper results to the lulynx mode.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Requires computing pairing distances within the batch, with O(N²) sorting overhead.
